computed: one declared m=4-to-m=5 common-ambient action homotopy
five source-labelled saddle continuations on fixed coarse and fine lambda meshes
Hessian nondegeneracy and inertia along those sampled paths
forward/reverse, mesh, reflection, and implicit-tangent controls

nonlinear upward manifolds or flow trajectories

disclosed_feasibility_pilot.implementation: A temporary Python/SymPy/SciPy calculation built the prospective m=5 midpoint action, embedded the retained m=4 roots, and ran the proposed 17-point forward/reverse continuation for the nominal and half/double stabilizer scales. No repository result artifact was written.
disclosed_feasibility_pilot.observed_half_and_double_stabilizer_path: all five paths retained inertia (5-,4+) and returned to the embedded m=4 roots; the worst disclosed residual was 8.236e-10 and the smallest disclosed absolute Hessian eigenvalue was 4.194

model_conventions.realification_order: interleaved real and imaginary parts in the declared complex order
model_conventions.holomorphic_domain: T is nonzero; this saddle calculation follows the retained positive-real-T branch

common_ambient_embedding.ambient: the nine-complex-dimensional m=5 nodal coordinate space
common_ambient_embedding.anchor_m: the source-dependent affine endpoint interpolant sampled at j/m, with T anchor zero
common_ambient_embedding.full_basis_definition: B interleaves P separately in the a and phi rows, copies T, and places q in the final a and phi columns
common_ambient_embedding.reflection: m5 nodal reversal intertwines B with m4 nodal reversal plus parity -1 on each added mode
common_ambient_embedding.orientation: det(B)>0 fixes the common-ambient coordinate orientation; no field-by-field sign correction is permitted. Flipping exactly one added column is a required basis-gauge mutation and must flip only the raw basis sign.

action_homotopy.endpoint_meaning: lambda=0 is an explicitly stabilized lift of the Phase-41 action, not equality with S5; lambda=1 is the m=5 midpoint action. S5 composed with the zero-added-mode affine m=4 embedding must be retained as an exact symbolic nonidentity control against action nesting.
action_homotopy.stabilizer_mutation_rule: multiply both kappa values by the listed positive scale, rerun every branch, and require the same lambda=1 roots and the same nonzero inertia; this is a candidate-path robustness test, not regulator independence

metric_and_local_orientation.endpoint_mobility: At lambda=0, inherit the byte-pinned Phase-42 shared-zero m=4 mobility M4 and define M0=B*blockdiag(M4,1/abs(kappa_a),1/abs(kappa_phi))*B.T. At the shared-zero lambda=1 m=5 saddle, diagonalize the real Hessian H5=O Lambda O.T with det(O)=+1 and define M1=O*diag(abs(Lambda)^(-1))*O.T. Both are positive mobilities in the same frozen m=5 nodal coordinates.
metric_and_local_orientation.primary_metric_path: M_geo(mu)=M0^(1/2)*(M0^(-1/2)*M1*M0^(-1/2))^mu*M0^(1/2), evaluated with symmetric positive-definite matrix powers
metric_and_local_orientation.positive_factor: Use the lower Cholesky factor L with positive diagonal, so M=L*L.T and det(L)>0.
metric_and_local_orientation.local_upward_plane: Diagonalize L.T*H_lambda*L. Map negative eigenvectors with a negative-real phase and positive eigenvectors with a positive-imaginary phase through L, realify in the frozen ambient order, and transport each nine-frame by signed-block orthogonal Procrustes alignment. Individual eigenvector signs are not invariant data.

two_parameter_paths.rule: The saddle depends only on lambda. Re-solving or changing a saddle as mu changes is an implementation error. Compare the transported endpoint upward planes and oriented-frame holonomies across all three paths.

metric_and_local_orientation.orientation_scope: This transports only the local saddle upward tangent orientation inside the declared common ambient space. It is not a Gamma-K intersection sign or a physical determinant line.
metric_and_local_orientation.basis_gauge_control: Negating the added-a basis column makes det(B) and the raw augmented-basis sign flip; multiplying them gives an invariant corrected sign. The physical lifted action is unchanged because the corresponding added coordinate also changes sign.

pre_output_clarification.change: The lambda=0 mobility is explicitly the Phase-42 m=4 mobility plus inverse-absolute-stabilizer mobilities pushed forward by B; lambda=1 remains the native m=5 Hessian mobility. This resolves an endpoint-metric wording ambiguity and changes no source branch, mesh, stabilizer, threshold, disclosed pilot observation, or desired result.

fixed_numerics.continuation: Start every branch from its immutable Phase-42 m=4 saddle embedded at lambda=0. Continue forward in the listed order. Reverse from the forward lambda=1 root without substituting a reflected or desired root.
fixed_numerics.finite_difference_tangent: independently re-solve at lambda plus/minus h from the frozen central root and form the signed central difference; retain both steps without selection
fixed_numerics.retention: retain every branch, mesh node, reverse node, tangent step, stabilizer mutation, metric-path sample, solver message, residual, Hessian spectrum, action, and orientation diagnostic

classification.supported: All exact contracts, five fine forward paths, reverse and coarse-mesh controls, reflection pairs, implicit-tangent ladders, positive metric paths, local upward-plane transports, and both stabilizer mutations pass the frozen checks.
classification.contradicted: A Hessian zero or branch loss is reproduced on both meshes and in reverse or stabilizer controls while input, solver, and finite-precision validity checks remain intact. This contradicts only the declared homotopy candidate.
classification.inconclusive: Any provenance, solver, mesh, tangent, metric, orientation, or mutation validity control fails without the independently reproduced zero or branch-loss pattern required for the contradicted label.

phase49_result_upstream_readiness_only.role: confirms the preceding m=4 local-flow implementation audit is complete; it is not used in the static saddle equations of Phase 50
